chunks: Let those fear who, if they left behind them weak offspring, would be concerned for them; so let them fear God and speak a right word.
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran use parental concern for children as a metaphor for fearing God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a call for spiritual mindfulness, where the natural fear parents feel for their weak offspring serves as a metaphor for the believer's fear of God regarding their own spiritual legacy. It emphasizes that just as one ensures material provision for children, one must ensure moral rectitude through 'Qawl Sadeed' (sound, clear speech) to guide the family toward righteousness. This concept underscores the responsibility of the head of the household to model piety and clarity in communication as a means of preserving the family's faith.
